name: Protime
verdict: Protime is part of SD Worx, which is 77.5% owned by WorxInvest, a holding entirely owned by the Belgian cooperative SD Worx for Society, itself held by two private foundations. Nothing found.
note: Time-registration and workforce-management brand, part of SD Worx (SD Worx press release, 2026-05-06); co-title sponsor of Team SD Worx-Protime. Rating note (issue #472, 2026-10-03): subsidiary of SD Worx; chain traced to foundation-held WorxInvest; no state owner, no human-rights finding found. 'none'.
